data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'heoran' meaning 'army' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. This name translates to 'ruler of the army' or 'ruler of the hearth'. The name Harriman carries the meaning “Ruler of the Hearth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Harriman usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the hearth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
